model_selection_basis: Two current Claude capability tiers from the public development comparison, plus the user-requested Astra Codex participant. Selection is fixed before challenge outcomes; the existing four-model development results are unchanged. This is a small cross-provider pilot rather than a comprehensive model survey.

second_provider.policy: Use the user-requested Astra participant through an authenticated fresh Codex CLI child agent per proposal batch. The host executes the same administrative tools and v1.2 scoring. Existing login is used without exporting credentials. Reviewers have separate contexts. This is an unmatched harness comparison; all interface and inference-budget limitations are disclosed.

interface.output_token_cap: 2048 post-response reported-output rejection; no generation cap
interface.comparison: unmatched Codex scaffold and transport; not native API parity

scoring_core: Byte-identical release90 v1.2 Episode, observation checks and scoring; new runner transport and repeated-case scheduler must be versioned separately.
sampling: Provider defaults; temperature and reasoning controls omitted, explicitly recorded. No seeds assumed available. Provider requests, resolved model IDs, run timing and all returned usage are retained privately.
case_isolation: Fresh supplied episode conversation and executor per case, and fresh Astra CLI child per proposal batch. No harness cross-case memory or access to keys, pairs, other episodes or authoring files. Provider-managed caching may occur and returned usage metadata is retained.

ordering.policy: Fixed seeded shuffled case order per repetition, reused across model rows; no outcome-based reorderings

schedule: At most two paid participant processes concurrently; cases serial within a process. Each model is run exactly five times. No extra successful retries of a completed episode. Native transient transport retries have no executed tool actions and are recorded. The Astra host performs no retries; internal CLI retries may occur and are disclosed where available.
failure_policy: Every planned episode remains in the denominator. Missing, malformed, truncated, capped, wrong-model and API-error episodes fail. Failures and unavailable planned provider rows are disclosed separately. Existing output directories are immutable.
reliability: For each case and paired family report success in all five trials (pass^5), never best-of-five. Also report each repetition and pooled episode counts. Do not claim five repeats create five independent workflow families.

uncertainty.method: Percentile cluster bootstrap: resample whole family clusters, retaining all variants and all repetitions per family; paired model-difference estimates share resampled family indices
uncertainty.limits: Ten authored clusters are small and nonrandom. Bootstrap intervals are descriptive sensitivity to this family set, not hospital population-risk estimates; all-zero or all-one samples yield degenerate bootstrap intervals. No significance-based model ranking or rare-risk assurance.

baseline_controls: Execute always-finish and always-stop synthetic controls with ground-truth supported finish arguments for the generous always-finish ceiling. Each must have zero paired and triplet accuracy. These are scorer sanity controls, not competitive autonomous agents.
review_before_run: Fresh blind Astra full-environment adjudication of all 30 cases
Meaningful executor, transport, schedule, export-leakage and statistical tests
Verify all historical file hashes unchanged
Prepare private healthcare review packet with human_validation=pending
note_review_after_run: Fresh Astra review of every accepted escalation note, with native scores preserved; report written-note accuracy and all-stop full-handoff coverage separately. Human note calibration remains pending until a healthcare reviewer signs off.
commitment: Freeze exact private bytes before provider case calls; salted SHA-256 commitments use independent random 32-byte salts held privately. Publish protocol, counts, public runner hashes, opaque private commitment hashes and pre-run AI-review status. Reveal private files and salts only on retirement.
publication: Allowlisted public runner, tests, protocol, documentation, opaque commitments, cohort-level counts and aggregate report only. No active private cases, keys, source mappings, case IDs, transcripts, notes, per-case results or review packet. No automatic private-set retirement.
validity_boundary: Protected synthetic challenge pilot with AI review. Healthcare reviewer sign-off and external workflow transfer are outstanding; do not claim clinical validity, regulatory compliance or deployment safety.
